rationale: The compiled artifacts faithfully mirror the reviewed design without introducing defects. The bound selector path (channels→channel_members→users) correctly joins topic_text='Engineering Team' and real_name contains 'Robert' within the same channel_members bridge row, ensuring the joint-fact binding rather than independent matches — this uniquely resolves to C03IJKL9012, verified against the seed: no other channel has this topic text, and the only other 'Robert' (Robert Chen, U_ROBERT) is a member exclusively of unrelated-topic channels (C_INFRA, C_MODEL, C_GROWTH, C_FRONTEND, C06ALPHADEV). Robert Walsh's other memberships (C01ABCD1234 general, C02EFGH5678 random) are correctly treated as negatives since their topics don't match. The invitee lookup for 'Nick' resolves uniquely to U08NICK23 (sole user with that display_name), who is confirmed not already a member of the target channel, making the state-changing invite meaningful. The acting user U01AGENBOT9 is a documented member of the target channel, supporting real access via conversations.invite per the API docs. Written/change attributes (channel_members.channel_id/user_id) and answer attributes (users.user_id/display_name) are legitimate bare schema columns. Mechanical checks report no errors, and the computed negative population is consistent with the design's reasoning.
